mapper.select: select cl.user_id, CASE WHEN cl.is_anonymous = 0 THEN u.userName ELSE '匿名' END AS userName, u.head as userHead, cl.title, cl.summary, cl.content, cl.to_user_info, cl.create_time, cl.type, cl.image_1 as image1, cl.image_2 as image2, cl.image_3 as image3 from confession_log cl left join user u on cl.user_id = u.id where cl.id = #{id}
select id, title, summary, content, to_user_info, create_time, type, image_1, image_2, image_3 from confession_log where id = #{id}
